description: What the Usage and plan tab of a hosted app or bot shows: the limits the plan gives it (memory, CPU, disk, whether its traffic is held to a daily budget), the latest reading of memory, CPU and disk with the time it was taken, the peaks of the last day, traffic by day for the last month with the totals for today and this week, the busiest ports out and in over the last week, and, for the account that owns the app, the next plan up with its price and what would change. Readings come from the stored five-minute samples, so a stopped or sleeping app is shown its last reading with the time instead of a zero that reads like a measurement. Needs the app id (bot_...) from list_bots. Refuses an app this account cannot see.
name: get_app_usage

at.description: When the reading was taken, ISO 8601, or null when the app has never been sampled.

cpu_limit_percent.description: What the whole allowance reads as; three cores is 300.

cpu_percent.description: CPU at the reading, as a percentage of one core.

disk_used_mb.description: Disk in use at the reading.

live.description: Whether the reading is current rather than the last one before it stopped.

memory_used_mb.description: Memory in use at the reading.

is_owner.description: Whether this token owns the app. Only the owner is shown a price or can upgrade.

next_plan.description: The next plan up, or null for a team member and for an app already on the largest tier.

changes.description: What would be different for this app.

price_cents.description: Price on the account billing cycle, in cents.

peaks.description: The highest readings of the last day.

hours.description: The window the peaks are taken over.

plan.description: What this app runs under, read from the things that enforce it.

cpus.description: vCPUs the container is created with.

disk_mb.description: The disk quota the node writes for this tier.

memory_mb.description: Memory the container is created with.

outbound.description: fixed for a free app list, open or allowlist for a paid one.

outbound_enforced.description: Whether the node blocks what is off the list, or only counts it.

region.description: The region the app runs in.

region_movable.description: Whether the owner may move it to another region.

traffic_budget_bytes.description: The daily allowance, or null when nothing is held to one.

traffic_metered.description: Whether traffic is held to a daily budget.

traffic.description: What the nodes counted on this container.

budget_bytes.description: The daily allowance, or null when nothing is held to one.

days.description: Every day of the last thirty, empty ones included.

month_bytes.description: Both ways, the last thirty days.

ports_in.description: The busiest inbound ports of the last week.

ports_out.description: The busiest outbound ports of the last week.

week_bytes.description: Both ways, the last seven days.

title: Get app usage and plan
